children: Ionic Digital Inc. reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue rising to $48.6M while the company swung to a consolidated net loss of $35.3M and diluted loss per share of $(0.94) versus net income of $31.9M and EPS of $0.85 in the year-ago quarter.
Revenue was $48.6M for Q2 2026, compared with $37.2M in the year-ago quarter; YoY change 30.8%.
Net income was a consolidated loss of $35.3M for Q2 2026, compared with net income of $31.9M in the year-ago quarter (swing vs. prior year).
Diluted earnings per share were $(0.94) for Q2 2026 versus $0.85 in the year-ago quarter.
Revenue mix shifted from bitcoin mining to digital infrastructure leasing, driving a 27.9% year-to-date increase and material leasing contributions.
Amended long-term 126-month Nscale triple-net lease at Ward County established approximately $1.9–$2.6B of contracted revenue.
Decommissioning of Ward County mining assets is complete and conversion to HPC/AI facilities is underway; initial lease payments began in November 2025.
Mining operations were significantly scaled down—reducing hashrate and miner fleet—which materially lowered mining costs and depreciation.
Headcount and stock-based compensation increased to support the strategic pivot to digital infrastructure and delivery of HPC/AI customer solutions.
